description: This file defines the Login controller class for account login-related functionality in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for rendering the login page, handling login requests, token-based login, and validation logic.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: Controller class for handling user login processes, including rendering login view, processing login requests, token-based login, and validation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the login page, prepares breadcrumb navigation, handles token mismatches, and sets up page data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Processes the login form submission, authenticates the user, manages session data, and redirects upon success or failure.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Handles token-based login, typically for login overrides, checks token validity, and creates user session upon success.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the current session and customer token are consistent, confirming an authenticated user session.
